name: Wax proofing
summary: A dressing of oil or wax worked into a dense cloth so that it sheds water; the owner renews it each year.
how: Warm the wax blend until it is liquid.
Work the wax into the cloth by hand or by machine, and press it into the seams.
Let the cloth cure, and renew the wax when water no longer beads on the face.

origin.note: Sailors and fishermen soak canvas in linseed oil to make it shed water.

adoptions.via: Scottish makers dress cotton with paraffin wax, which does not stiffen in the cold, for the country jacket.
A Swedish maker of outdoor kit waxes poly-cotton twill for the Nordic field jacket.
